result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): B keeps all the text over deep indigo and purple, so the title, dates and tagline stay clearly legible. Its amber button stands out against the mauve, and the soft lantern bokeh makes it feel nighttime and festive. In A the tagline and button sit over the pinkish-orange part of the sky, which lowers contrast and lets the button blend in, and a murky brown band at the bottom muddies the gradient. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): A keeps all text and the button over the dark indigo-to-purple part of the sky, and saves the warm sunset glow for the bottom edge. The orange button stands out clearly, and the soft lantern bokeh feels festive. B lets the sunset climb too high, so the tagline and orange button sit on a pinkish-orange area where the button partly blends in. B also has a muddy brownish band where the orange horizon fades to black at the bottom.
